subject: english
title: Unit 6 Writing
subtitle: Contrast writing — the Land and Sea Turtles model, then a paragraph about warm and cold corals.

content: Identify the differences between land turtles and sea turtles in the model text.
Find every contrast expression in the model text (Writing Activity 1).
Plan a contrast paragraph about warm corals and cold corals before writing it (Activity 2).
language: Use but, however and In contrast, each in its own position.
Punctuate each one correctly: a comma before but, one on each side of however, one after In contrast.
Write a contrast paragraph of four sentences or more using all three expressions, then share it and take notes (Activity 3).

notes: The model text "Land and Sea Turtles", the Contrast Writing definition box and all three activity rubrics are verbatim from Student Book pp. 104-105, read from the book itself. Note the shape of the lesson: Leo reads about turtles in Activity 1, then Activity 2 asks him to write about warm and cold corals - a different topic, and the Reading on pp. 102-103 is where every fact for it comes from. The warm/cold coral table on the plan slide is the Reading's own Activity 4.
